title: Asymptotically free solutions of the scalar flow equations
summary: We analyse solutions of the flow equations of the renormalisation group for the n-point Schwinger functions of scalar field theory in four-dimensional Euclidean space with nonpolynomial boundary conditions. We show that there exist UV asymptotically free solutions of this type which are Bose symmetric, invariant under the Euclidean group, analytic in the flow parameter and the momenta, and satisfy the Osterwalder-Schrader growth condition.
